title: Liquidity Pivot and Banking Update
summary: Liquidity turning point and bank resilience.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

evidence.title: Gradual tariff pass-through in 2025
evidence.finding: Five-retailer price data show gradual 2025 pass-through; goods imported from China were 8.5% higher year over year in December, with at least 30% tariff pass-through April-December. Coverage is not all consumer spending.

evidence.title: Q4 2025 GDP second estimate
evidence.finding: BEA estimated reduced federal services during the shutdown subtracted about one percentage point from Q4 annualized real GDP growth. This is a specific quarterly effect, not a permanent one-percent GDP loss.

evidence.title: Time-varying reserve demand curve
evidence.finding: Study estimates reserve satiation above 12-13% of bank assets using 2010-24 data. Reserve demand shifts over time; the estimate is not a binding fixed regulatory minimum.

evidence.title: Review of Silicon Valley Bank supervision: key takeaways

evidence.title: Financial Stability Report: funding risks
evidence.finding: Semi-liquid private-credit vehicles faced rising redemption requests and caps in Q1 2026; risks remained manageable. Bank commitments and funded amounts both increased. Locked funds and semi-liquid vehicles have different liquidity structures.

claims.reason: The illustration assumes 50% of funded loans default with zero recovery. framework_lessons: Count contingent funding before declaring losses contained.
assessment: The updated liquidity pivot was timely: QT ended and reserve-management buying began in December. Banking resilience was supported by subsequent data, but the treatment of undrawn lines as not yet at risk is incorrect. Bitcoin failed to follow the simple bullish liquidity narrative on a disclosed annual sensitivity.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.

Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
